::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 11th 1871  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection C0171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Mrs Johns](people/person_772.qmd)
Thank you for your kind note. The second part of the little book is already half way printed - so I hope it will be ready the time the first is finished.[^1]

I believe I am going to London on Monday week, and shall be away for about a month, unless indeed the scarlatina in the parish spreads so as to prevent my going; and then I am afraid it would be equally in the way of meeting you.

So I am afraid I cannot leave the coming to afternoon tea - which I should much like to do - till after I come home. I hope that by the time you will be stronger

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY perhaps refers here to *Musings over the 'Christian Year'*?
